thread.title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally

author: morningstar.com
title: Dow's earnings reporters providing a 92-point boost to futures' rally
text:
Of the 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average components, 29 are trading higher in the premarket, with the three that reported third-quarter earnings accounting for nearly a half of the gains in Dow futures . Of the other reporters, shares of UnitedHealth Group (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/unitedhealth-raises-outlook-after-earnings-beat-2018-10-16) Inc. (UNH) climbed 3.2%, Goldman Sachs (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/goldman-sachs-top-estimates-2018-10-16) Group Inc. (GS) rose 2.2% and Johnson & Johnson (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/johnson-johnson-reports-q3-profit-revenue-beats-2018-10-16)(JNJ) gained 0.4%. The stocks' price gains are adding about a combined 92 points to the Dow's price, and futures are up 227 points. The most active Dow stock was Apple Inc.'s (AAPL), which rose 0.9%. The lone Dow decliner Coca-Cola Co.'s stock (CVX), which lost 0.6%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1332ET
